cells.detail: Where the proof stops: Network and distributor availability do not establish issuer-register title, universal eligibility, transaction scale or identical rights across jurisdictions.

cells.text: Access + identity (capability); Stock + rights record (outside); Post-trade completion (support)
items: Access + identity · Admission / KYC, Transfer restrictions: The model describes token-level KYC, geography and eligibility controls.
Stock + rights record · Product issuer, Title / entitlement record, Corporate actions + proxy: It is a foreign product-model comparison, not a U.S. TSV stock-rights finding.
Post-trade completion · Custody, Securities settlement: Custodial brokerage backing and market-value redemption illustrate external post-trade dependencies.

cells.text: The public description is company-authored and the product is offered outside the U.S.; it does not establish issuer-register title, U.S. NMS trading, TSV qualification or the same legal rights as the Ondo U.S. model.
cells.note: Watch: Exact issuer and offering documents, custodian, beneficial-interest record, voting, dividends, redemption, jurisdiction and regulatory status.
